title: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 Flaw Enables Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
content_md: Ivanti released security updates for Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) to address CVE-2026-104935, a high-severity authentication-bypass vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands. The company disclosed the issue on October 13, 2026. It confirmed that exploitation had affected a limited number of customers at the time of disclosure.
